Messages.Author: DeistMutts
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message news:<3EBEAAA...@white-wolf.com>...

> reyda wrote:
> > Subject: [D3ck] ...
>
> Why would you include a subject keyword and the purposefully negate the
> utility of a subject keyword?

Must be an 'in' thing for internet.. But curiously.. is anyone
thinking what I'm thinking? That 1000 years down the line, assuming no
end-of-the-world event, would ANY future linguist or historian would
actually consider this 'old language' and have college students
memorize the different ways of writing/using such words and usage
(like the word 'Word!') ?

That relates to the other question I had in my mostly-useless brain
for years.. did ppl think Odyssey was a bedtime story for kids back in
those days? What is complicated now.. is probably a joke back then..
and then makes me wonder if my mediocre grades in English was actually
justifiable in action.. trivial things you think about while driving
in a Honda Accord.. (I think that was the brand for that commercial..)

---DeistMutts, Prince of Wakawakashakalaka---
